T: Swap the compass for a bottle.
D: A young sailor and an astronomer team up with Jack Sparrow to find the Trident of Poseidon.
P: Serve the drinks when Jack trades his compass for a bottle of rum.
S: Thin baked parmesan rounds with thyme, golden and crisp
Parmesan and thyme spooned into coin shapes on baking paper, baked at 190C for 6 minutes until golden, served with fig jam.
Prawns in an ice cold soda water batter, fried until crisp, with a lime dip
Prawns dipped in a cold batter of flour, cornflour and soda water, fried at 180C until puffed and crisp, with sweet chilli and lime.
Carina reading the stars to find the Trident

Cheddar cracker dough rolled thin, cut into stars, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp. Rub 100g cold diced butter into 150g plain flour with half a teaspoon salt and a pinch of cayenne. Mix in 150g finely grated vintage cheddar and 2 tbsp cold water and press into a dough. Chill 20 minutes, roll out 3mm thick and cut into stars of different sizes. Bake on lined trays at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp. Cool and serve with a whipped feta and honey dip.
M: Snapper fillets poached in coconut milk with tomato, garlic and chilli
Snapper fillets simmered in coconut milk with tomato, chilli, garlic and lime for 10 minutes, served over rice.
Will and Elizabeth reunited at the very end

Pork belly scored and roasted at 160C for 3 hours, crackling blasted crisp at 240C, with apple sauce and roast potatoes. Score the skin of a 1.5kg pork belly, pat very dry and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Rub with oil and plenty of salt. Roast on a rack at 160C for 2.5 hours, then turn up to 240C for 20 to 30 minutes until the crackling blisters. Roast 1kg potatoes in the fat for the last hour. Simmer 3 peeled chopped apples with 2 tbsp sugar and a splash of water for 10 minutes for apple sauce. Rest the pork 10 minutes and cut into thick slices.
W: Soft dough rolled around guava paste and steamed in foil

Soft rolled sponge filled with sticky guava, steamed until tender and sliced warm, with a whipped rum butter melting over the top. Make a soft dough of 250g self-raising flour, 60g butter, 60g sugar and 150ml milk. Roll out, spread with 250g guava paste, roll up, wrap in buttered foil and steam 1 hour. Serve with 80g butter, 100g icing sugar and 30ml rum beaten together.
K: Jack's rum, ginger and lime highball
Dark rum floated over spicy ginger beer and lime

Dark rum over ice with fresh lime and spicy ginger beer, stirred once and finished with a lime wedge and a slice of fresh ginger. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze a quarter of a lime into each and drop in the wedge. Pour 180ml cold spicy ginger beer into each glass, then gently float 45ml dark rum over the top. Add a thin slice of fresh ginger and serve with a stirrer. For landlubbers, skip the rum and add an extra squeeze of lime.

Sear the tofu in half the oil until golden on both sides and set aside.

Squeeze in lime and serve over the rice.
